description:
Looks up the ERC-8004 agents an address owns or is the agentWallet of.

- **Cost:** 0.005 USDC per call, paid over x402.
- **Inputs:** `chainId` and `address` (path). The address may be in any letter case.
- **Returns:** each agent's summary and the `roles` the address holds, by `agentId` ascending. An address tied to no agent gets an empty list, not an error.
- **Errors:**
  - 404 `unknown_chain`: use the chain this deployment serves.
- **Next:**
  - `agentProfile`: read one agent's checks and feedback.

Costs 5000 base units (0.005 USDC) per call. Payment goes in params._meta["x402/payment"]; use an x402-aware MCP client (see https://docs.arcgate.dev/#arcgate/description/mcp-for-agents).

inputSchema.description: The chain and the address to look up.

address.description: A 0x-prefixed 20-byte address, any letter case. Matches agents it owns and agents whose agentWallet it is.

chainId.description: The chain's EIP-155 id, e.g. 5042 for Arc mainnet. Only the chain this deployment serves is answered; any other is 404 unknown_chain.

name: agentWallet
